newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RAKVERE BUYS MAJORITY OF RIGA FACTORY.
newsitem.headline: RAKVERE BUYS MAJORITY OF RIGA FACTORY.

text.p: Rakvere Meat Factory said on Thursday that it had acquired a 67 percent stake in the Riga Meat Factory on Wednesday.
"We will immediately start projects to make better use of our common opportunities," Toomas Kouhkna, Rakvere's council chairman, said in a statement.
The share price in the deal is a business secret, Rakvere's chairman, Peeter Maspanov, told Reuters.
Maspanov said Rakvere had signed a deal with an individual.
Riga Meat Factory, the largest meat processor in Latvia, has been reconstructed and some of its equipment has been replaced, Maspanov said.
"The production opportunities (of the factory) are good," he added.
Riga Meat Factory had a turnover of 16.5 million lats (391 million kroons) and a net profit of 148,000 lats (3.5 million kroons) in 1996. It has a 20 percent share of Latvia's meat products market.
It has seven shops and a whole-sale warehouse in Riga, which will start selling the production of Rakvere.
The meat factories plan to specialize in different product groups to use their production capacities in the most optimal way, the statement said.
Maspanov told Reuters that Rakvere will now begin a detailed examination of the investment needs of the Latvian company.
"It is too early to say today, the decisions have not been finalized," he added.
Maspanov said the deal was initiated by the Latvian company.
Rakvere Meat Factory is the largest and most modern meat processor in Estonia, with a turnover of 546.7 million kroons and a net profit of 4.3 million kroons in 1996.
